title: Databricks Personal access token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one non-hex byte vs the tool-corroborated lowercase-hex body (gitleaks: [a-f0-9]{32}; trufflehog: [0-9a-f]{32}). Twin of "Databricks Personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
